description:
Get one Thai alphabet letter's full details.

    ``letter_ref`` is a numeric letter ID, a URL slug, or the exact Thai
    glyph (e.g. "ก"). Returns the glyph, English and Thai names, letter type
    (consonant/vowel/tone mark/special), consonant class for consonants,
    romanization, IPA, a description, the associated memory word, audio and a
    stroke-order animation URL, plus its silalingo.com page.
name: get_letter

outputSchema.description: One Thai alphabet letter: consonant, vowel, tone mark or special.

associated_word.description: The word used to remember the letter, e.g. 'chicken'
associated_word.title: Associated Word

consonant_class.description: mid / high / low for consonants, empty otherwise
consonant_class.title: Consonant Class

outputSchema.title: LetterDetails

title: Get Thai Letter
